nodes.speaker: The Kestrel
nodes.text: A bottle, a coin at the top of its arc, and a ricochet off cookware. Three for three. The warrants say 'menace'; the shooting says 'craftsman'.

choices.text: The pan did most of the work.
Your toss was honest. Thank you.

nodes.speaker: The Kestrel
nodes.text: Then the pan can have the warrant. Don't tell Preacher; he'd frame it.

nodes.speaker: The Kestrel
nodes.text: Always. Cheating's for people who plan to lose.

nodes.speaker: The Kestrel
nodes.text: A deal's a deal. Consider the hat tipped, Mr Calloway. I'll tell three counties the wind kept me — and I'll be watching what you do about Vane. Politely. From a distance.

nodes.speaker: The Kestrel
nodes.text: You're the politest criminal I have ever hunted. It's very irritating.
